The '''Nilgaard sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Planets in Nilgaard included [[Emmer]], [[Dalos IV]], and [[Reaper's World/Legends|Reaper's World]]. It bordered the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] and was along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].
